e.title_en: An empty repository whose stated reason for existing is to improve the discoverability of a dataset hosted somewhere else: its readme is one French sentence saying the directory is empty and was created to boost the search ranking of a Hugging Face dataset, while the organisation behind it describes itself as a community mirror that invites original owners to claim ownership.

e.summary: **zelros-insurance-fr**（ModelScope 数据集 `french-datasets/zelros-insurance-fr`）**是一个**内容为空的**数据仓库****——**逐字自述（法语）为**「**Ce répertoire est vide, il a été créé pour améliorer le référencement du jeu de données huggingface.co/datasets/zelros/insurance-fr.**」**。**本次实测**：**类型为数据集****、**许可字段逐字为 **`other`****、**存储 **115,343 字节****、**下载 **0 次****、**创建与**最后修改**同为 **2026-08-27****、**⭐ 而 **README **只有 **138 个字符****（**⭐ 即**全文**就是**上面那一句**）**；**⭐ 其所属组织**逐字自述为**「**This organization was created as a community mirror to host open artifacts including models and datasets.**」**，**并**逐字邀请**原作者**认领**（**逐字**「**If you are the owner of these repos and would like to claim ownership and management right for this organization, please feel free to reach out to**」**——**逐字續**「**contact@modelscope.cn**」**）**。**⭐⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**中国的模型与数据集平台：数据集这一面**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四处最值得看**：**① **⭐ 一个**空仓库**可以**在平台上**被当作**一个数据集**（**⭐ 即**它**占着**一条**数据集条目**，**而**内容**为空**）**；**② **⭐ 而**它**不掩饰**这一点**——**README **把**「**它是空的**」与**「**为什么建它**」**并列写出**；**③ **这不是**一个**数据集**，**而是**一个**指向**另一个平台的**路标****（**⭐ 目标**逐字为 **Hugging Face 上的同名数据集**）**；**④ **⭐ 其**组织**明确**承认**自己是**社区镜像**，**并**给出**认领渠道**——**⭐ 即**平台侧**承认**这类**搬运**的存在**，**并**把**归属争议**放到**前台**。**⚠️ 本次**未下载**任何内容**。

e.summary_en: This ModelScope dataset **is a repository with no content**, described verbatim in one French sentence stating that the directory is empty and was created to improve the discoverability of a dataset hosted on Hugging Face. **Measured this round**: typed as a dataset, licensed under a field reading simply other, a storage size of about a hundred and fifteen kilobytes, zero downloads, created and last modified on the same day in late August, and a readme of one hundred and thirty-eight characters, which is the whole of it. **The organisation behind it describes itself as a community mirror that hosts open artifacts including models and datasets, and invites original owners to claim ownership and management rights through a support address.** **This entry belongs to the round theme of a Chinese model and dataset platform, on its dataset side.** **Four things are worth reading: an empty repository can be counted as a dataset on the platform; it does not hide that fact, since the readme puts the emptiness and the reason for creating it side by side; it is not a dataset but a signpost to another platform, naming the Hugging Face dataset it points at; and the organisation openly declares itself a community mirror and publishes a route for ownership claims, so the platform acknowledges this kind of copying and puts the ownership question in the foreground.** **Nothing was downloaded this round.**
e.body:
**zelros-insurance-fr**（ModelScope 数据集 `french-datasets/zelros-insurance-fr`）**是一个**内容为空的**数据仓库****——**逐字自述（法语）为**「**Ce répertoire est vide, il a été créé pour améliorer le référencement du jeu de données huggingface.co/datasets/zelros/insurance-fr.**」**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**中国的模型与数据集平台：数据集这一面**」**。

**可核实信息（均 ModelScope 数据集接口实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 一个空仓库在平台上被算作一个数据集，**而**它**自己不掩饰****——**⭐ 本次实测**其字段逐字为**：**类型 **4**（**数据集）**、**许可 **`other`**、**存储 **115,343 字节****、**下载 **0 次****、**`GmtCreate` 与 **`GmtModified` **同为 **1787830211**（**⭐ 换算为 **2026-08-27**）**、**⭐ 而 **`ReadmeContent` **仅 **138 个字符****。**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**是本条的核心**：**⭐ 即**平台**把它**列为**一个数据集**，**而**它**在**同一份**说明里**直接写出**「**本目录是空的**」**与**「**建它是为了**提升**另一个平台**那个数据集的**可发现性**」**——**⭐ 官方字段**说它是**数据**，**而**作者**自己说它不是**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 它**不是数据集**，**而是**一个**跨平台的**路标****——**⭐ 其**README **逐字指向** `huggingface.co/datasets/zelros/insurance-fr`**（**⭐ 即**目标**在**另一个**模型与数据集平台**上**）**；**⭐ 本词条**如实指出**：**这类**条目的**实际作用**是**在**本平台的**检索里**占位**，**并**把**流量**引向**别处**——**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**检索时**若**只看**条目名与**下载量**，**很容易**把**这类**空壳**当成**真数据**（**⭐ 而**本条**下载量 **0** 已是一个**提示**）**。**⭐⭐ ③ 其所属组织**明确承认是**社区镜像**，**并**给出**认领渠道****——**⭐ 本次实测**该组织说明逐字含**「**This organization was created as a community mirror to host open artifacts including models and datasets.**」**，**并**逐字续**「**If you are the owner of these repos and would like to claim ownership and management right for this organization, please feel free to reach out to**」**——**逐字續**「**contact@modelscope.cn**」**；**⭐ 该组织**创建于 **1787686911**（**⭐ 即 **2026-08-25**）**，**⭐ 即**这个镜像组织**只比**本条**早两天**建立**。**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**值得记**：**⭐ 即**「**社区镜像**」**这一形态**把**归属问题**放在**明处**——**⭐ 它**不假装**自己是**原始发布方**，**而**邀请**原作者**来**认领**；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**引用**这类**数据集**时**应当**回溯**到**原始地址**，**并**说明**自己所引的是**哪一个副本**。**⭐⭐ ④ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[insuranceqa-original]] 同样是**「**同一份数据的**另一个副本**」**这一形态**、**[[snorkel-multiturn-underwriting]] 在本轮**也被**另一个平台**镜像（**⭐ 见本轮记录**）**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**内容为空、**只为引流的**跨平台路标**」这一**更极端**的形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较****。

**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 本条最值得借的四件事**：**① **看**下载量**与**存储大小**（**⭐ 空壳**两项**都会**很可疑**）**；**② **读**README 的第一句**（**⭐ 本条**把**真相**写在**第一句**）**；**③ **跨平台**引用**要**回到**原始地址**；**④ **见到「**镜像组织**」**要**留意**归属与**再分发许可**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有下载该仓库的任何内容**（**⭐ 因**其**自述为空**）**，**故**不主张**其中**有任何**数据**，**也**不主张**其**与**所述 **Hugging Face 数据集**的关系**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只读**数据集接口返回的**元数据与 **README**。**③ ⚠️ 未核实**其**所指的 **Hugging Face 数据集**是否存在、**内容为何、**许可是什么**（**⭐ 本词条**不替它**作保**）**。**④ ⚠️ 未核实**该镜像组织**是否**获得**任何**原始作者**授权**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实**「**提升可发现性**」**这一**自述目的**是否**另有商业动机**（**⭐ 本词条**只记录**其自述**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ 本条目**所记为 **2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 并如实提示**：**本条**描述的是**一个空仓库**，**不是**一份**可用的**保险数据**。
e.body_hk:
**zelros-insurance-fr**（ModelScope 數據集 `french-datasets/zelros-insurance-fr`）**是一個**內容為空的**數據倉庫****——**逐字自述（法語）為**「**Ce répertoire est vide, il a été créé pour améliorer le référencement du jeu de données huggingface.co/datasets/zelros/insurance-fr.**」**。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**中國的模型與數據集平台：數據集這一面**」**。

**可核實資訊（均 ModelScope 數據集介面實測）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 一個空倉庫在平台上被算作一個數據集，**而它自己不掩飾****——**⭐ 欄位逐字為**：**類型 4（**數據集）**、**許可 `other`**、**存儲 115,343 位元組**、**下載 0 次**、**`GmtCreate` 與 `GmtModified` 同為 1787830211**（**⭐ 即 2026-08-27**）**、**⭐ 而 `ReadmeContent` 僅 138 個字符****。**⭐ 官方欄位說它是數據**，**而作者自己說它不是**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 它不是數據集，**而是**一個跨平台的路標****——**⭐ README 逐字指向 `huggingface.co/datasets/zelros/insurance-fr`**；**⭐ 這類條目的實際作用是**在本平台檢索裡占位**，**並把流量引向別處**——**⭐ 對 RIAA**：**只看到條目名與下載量**，**很容易**把這類空殼**當成真數據**。**⭐⭐ ③ 其組織明確承認是**社區鏡像**，**並給出認領渠道****——**逐字含 This organization was created as a community mirror to host open artifacts including models and datasets.**，**並逐字續 If you are the owner of these repos and would like to claim ownership and management right for this organization, please feel free to reach out to**——**逐字續 contact@modelscope.cn****；**⭐ 該組織創建於 1787686911（**即 2026-08-25**）**——**⭐ 即**它只比本條早兩天建立**。**⭐ 「**社區鏡像**」把歸屬問題放在明處**。**⭐⭐ ④ 與池內條目的關係**：[[insuranceqa-original]]、[[snorkel-multiturn-underwriting]]——**⭐ 本條補上的是**「**內容為空、**只為引流的跨平台路標**」這一更極端的形態**。

**對 RIAA**：**⭐ 四件事值得借**：**① **看下載量與存儲大小**；**② **讀 README 第一句**；**③ **跨平台引用要回到原始位址**；**④ **見到鏡像組織要留意歸屬與再分發許可**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**沒有下載該倉庫的任何內容**，**不主張**其中有任何數據**，**也不主張**其與所述 Hugging Face 數據集的關係**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只讀數據集介面返回的元資料與 README**。**③ ⚠️ 未核實**其所指的 Hugging Face 數據集是否存在、**內容為何、**許可是什麼**。**④ ⚠️ 未核實**該鏡像組織是否獲得任何原始作者授權**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核實**「**提升可發現性**」這一自述目的是否另有商業動機**。**⑥ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**；**⚠️ 本條描述的是一個空倉庫**，**不是**一份可用的保險數據**。
e.body_en:
This ModelScope dataset **is a repository with no content**, described verbatim in one French sentence stating that the directory is empty and was created to improve the discoverability of a dataset hosted on Hugging Face. **This entry belongs to the round theme of a Chinese model and dataset platform, on its dataset side.**

**Verified information, all measured from the platform dataset interface**: **first, an empty repository is counted as a dataset, and it does not hide the fact.** The recorded fields are a dataset type, a licence reading simply other, a storage size of about a hundred and fifteen kilobytes, zero downloads, identical creation and modification timestamps in late August, and a readme of one hundred and thirty-eight characters. **That is the core of this entry: the official fields call it data while the author says in the same breath that it is not, naming both the emptiness and the reason for creating it.** **Second, it is not a dataset but a cross-platform signpost**, the readme pointing verbatim at a Hugging Face dataset. **The practical effect of such an entry is to occupy a slot in this platform search results and route traffic elsewhere, and the lesson for this project is that reading only a name and a download count makes it easy to mistake an empty shell for real data, the zero download count being the first hint.** **Third, the organisation behind it declares itself a community mirror and publishes a route for ownership claims.** Its description states that the organisation was created as a community mirror to host open artifacts including models and datasets, and invites owners of the repositories to claim ownership and management rights through a support address, which the organisation was created for two days before this repository appeared. **A mirror that states the arrangement openly, rather than pretending to be the original publisher, puts the ownership question in the foreground, and a citation of such a dataset should trace back to the original address and say which copy was used.** **Fourth, relative to existing entries**: one pooled entry records another copy of a corpus published elsewhere and a pooled entry for an underwriting dataset appears mirrored on this platform as well, **so this entry supplies the more extreme form: a cross-platform signpost with no content whose only purpose is discoverability. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **four practices transfer: check download counts and storage sizes, since both look suspicious for a shell; read the first sentence of a readme, which here carries the whole truth; trace cross-platform citations back to the original address; and treat a mirror organisation as a signal to examine ownership and redistribution terms.**

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, nothing in this repository was downloaded**, since it describes itself as empty, **so no claim is made that it contains any data or that it bears any particular relationship to the Hugging Face dataset it names**. **Second, only the metadata and readme returned by the dataset interface were read.** **Third, whether the Hugging Face dataset it points at exists, what it contains and under what licence were not verified, and this entry does not vouch for it.** **Fourth, whether the mirror organisation holds any authorisation from the original authors was not verified. Fifth, whether the stated purpose of improving discoverability conceals a commercial motive was not verified**, only the self-description being recorded. **Sixth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11 and states plainly that it describes an empty repository rather than any usable insurance data.**
